doc: Given a packed value whose low 16 bits are a signed entity/state code (a0) and an output buffer (a1): if the code equals 0x38, runs the status-refresh pass func_800481E0() then the cleanup pass func_80047C00(). Then looks up/allocates the slot for the code via func_80047CD8(code); if a slot pointer was found/allocated, zeroes *a1 and registers a callback (func_800499DC) with arg a1 via func_8003E4FC(0xFF, func_800499DC, a1). Returns the func_80047CD8 result (NULL if not found).
calls: int func_800499DC(int *a0) -- only address taken, not called
